text: {"lessons":["Taking profits felt rewarding, but repeated sales of Stock A and D did not ensure my account kept rising; I should decide based on each holding’s future prospects, not the gain so far.","I sold Stock C after small and larger gains, then made no trades during later declines. I should avoid letting the pleasure of gains or the pain of losses dictate inconsistent decisions.","My account value moved both up and down, and recent price changes did not provide a dependable signal. I should avoid frequent reactionary trading and make deliberate choices rather than trying to predict random movements."]}
